sources.notes: Authors' institutional abstract read directly. Article DOI: 10.1016/j.explore.2020.02.008. The institutional page is dated August 1; journal issue is July–August 2020.

insights.title: Experience research asks a different question
insights.body: A 2020 survey studied 83 self-identified trance channelers and their reported experiences. A separate content study analyzed messages from 13 channels. These designs describe participants and messages; they do not establish an extraterrestrial source. The first study also cautions against assuming that self-reported channeling automatically implies pathology.
